_readme: Machine-read deployment config — owned by the CLI and /setup-my-brain.
Edit as text (never via Obsidian's property panel; this is not frontmatter).
timezone: the vault owner's IANA timezone name, e.g. Europe/Brussels.
owner: the vault owner's person slug in 50-people/, the join key for metrics.
account_hint: an identifier of the connector account that IS this vault's
account, copied VERBATIM from the connector's whoami (Plaud
get_current_user: the id or email field; Microsoft 365 get_me: mail or
userPrincipalName). Never a display name — and note that Apple/Google
sign-ins often give the connector a synthetic address, so the email you
signed up with may never appear in its whoami at all. A connector whose
signed-in account does not match its hint is refused before any content
is listed. Binding a vault to an account is a conscious act: write the
hint here, explicitly.
feedback.repo: the delaware-created GitHub repo (owner/name) that /report-feedback files issues on; null until provisioning sets it.
sync.start-date: the vault's horizon (ISO date), set to the provisioning
date by /setup-my-brain and /provision-vault. No adapter ever lists,
fetches, or writes a meeting dated before it — recurring calendar series
otherwise drag in occurrences from years back. Backfilling earlier
meetings is a deliberate, interactive act, never the default.
adapters.m365.home_domains: every email domain the vault owner's own
organisation uses — get_me's mail and userPrincipalName domains are the
seed (/setup-my-brain writes them); a multi-domain organisation
(subsidiaries, legacy names) must list all of them. A meeting organised
from any other domain is hosted in another organisation's tenant, whose
Teams transcripts this account can never read — sync-recordings lists
those occurrences as external and never fetches them. Null disables the
filter (every listed occurrence is fetched).
messages: the nightly mail and Teams feed (the sync-messages skill). Off until the owner consents; consented-at, scope and exclusions are written by the CLI only.
